source: rumi-style-explorations slime v4 palette + render style; face locked per Sept-2026 team survey (two eyes, one mouth)
opening: A single 3x3 grid image on a plain pure white background (#FFFFFF), showing 9 cute 3D-rendered emoji designs (Pixar-style character render with Apple-emoji framing: glossy, soft three-point studio lighting, ultra-clean) of the SAME character, one per cell, each cell labeled in small gray text below the character. No cell borders, no background tints, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no reflections on the background. The character: "Rumi", a cute translucent slime creature - a soft rounded teardrop-shaped blob of frosted white-and-pale-blue gel (glossy, jelly-like, soft subsurface scattering, faintly glowing from within with pale-blue #A8C7FF light, with a clearly visible pale-blue tinted rim so the silhouette reads against the white background), and on its front a deep NAVY #001F3F rounded face patch carrying Rumi's logo mark as its face (see the reference image): two round glowing WHITE dots joined by one continuous glowing white smile curve, the dots sitting at the two ends of the curve so eyes and mouth form ONE connected shape. It has no arms, legs, or fingers - it gestures by stretching soft rounded gel pseudopods out of its body or by reshaping its whole body. Strict palette: frosted white/pale-blue gel body, navy face patch, glowing white face features. No other colors.
closing: Every cell keeps the same identity: one clean unbroken translucent white/pale-blue slime blob with a smoothly rounded gently flattened base, navy face patch, and the connected dots-and-smile logo face. Expressions may change the shape of the two dots (hearts, squints, stars, closed curves) and bend the connecting curve (frown, wobble, open laugh), but the two dots ALWAYS stay joined to the ends of the one curve, exactly like the logo. NO drips, NO trailing strands, NO puddle, NO liquid pooling. Cute, friendly, Apple-like restraint, high resolution, evenly spaced grid, each character fully inside its own cell. HARD RULE: in every single cell the connecting lines from each eye down to the mouth are drawn as part of the glowing mark - when the eyes become squint arcs or closed curves, the connecting line starts from the end of each arc; when the mouth opens wide (laugh, celebrate) the open mouth sits at the bottom of the connected curve with the two side lines still running up to the eyes; a frown is the same connected shape with the middle of the curve bent upward. The face is NEVER three separate marks (two eyes plus a detached mouth).

grids.emotions: 1) Happy - calm resting teardrop blob, soft even glow. 2) Wink - body tilted a little to one side, playful lean. 3) Wave - one side of the body stretched up into a rounded gel paddle mid-wave, three small motion arcs beside it. 4) Thumbs Up - a gel pseudopod shaped like a rounded thumbs-up, body leaning forward proudly. 5) Heart Eyes - body swaying gently, three small glowing pale-blue hearts floating up beside the head. 6) Laugh - body squashed shorter and wider mid-laugh, motion arcs on both sides, tiny gel droplets bouncing off. 7) Thinking - a gel pseudopod resting under the face patch like a hand on a chin, a faint glowing ellipsis of three pale-blue dots above. 8) Sad - body slumped low and wide, drooping, a single big glowing teardrop beside the head, dim glow. 9) Celebrate - two gel pseudopods thrown high, a shower of translucent pale-blue bubbles and confetti dots above. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

1) Done - body upright and satisfied, a big glowing pale-blue checkmark floating above the head. 2) Working - body leaning forward, a gel pseudopod tapping, three glowing typing dots and a small progress bar floating above. 3) Loading - body perfectly still, a glowing circular spinner of pale-blue tick marks floating above the head. 4) Searching - a pseudopod holding a small glassy magnifying glass with a navy rim up beside the face, body leaning in. 5) Idea - body stretched taller with a rounded lightbulb-like top glowing much brighter, soft rays and sparkles bursting out. 6) Writing - a pseudopod holding a small pale-blue gel pencil with navy edge, body hunched over a little. 7) Error - body glitching - broken pale-blue pixel blocks and horizontal glitch lines shifting across the body, small fragments displaced. 8) Warning - body shrunk and tense, a big glowing pale-blue exclamation mark floating above, a few worry lines radiating from the head. 9) Blocked - two pseudopods crossed firmly in front of the body, body squared-off and planted. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

1) Sleeping - body settled low and round, two pseudopods folded under like a pillow, three glowing z Z z letters floating up, dimmer glow. 2) Low Battery - body sagging and deflated, a nearly-empty glowing battery icon floating above, glow almost out. 3) Surprised - body shot up tall and thin like a startled drop, small shock lines radiating from the head. 4) Confused - body tilted, the whole head twisted a little, a big glowing question mark floating above. 5) Shy - body turned three-quarters away, curled inward, soft pale-blue blush glow patches on both sides of the face, a pseudopod half covering the face. 6) Crying - body wobbling, glowing pale-blue teardrops streaming down both sides and pooling as small droplets, dim glow. 7) Crying Laughing - body doubled over laughing, tears flying off both sides, motion arcs everywhere. 8) Angry - body puffed up with soft rounded bumps, a glowing pale-blue anger mark (four short radiating lines) on the upper right of the head, faint steam wisps, glow pulsing. 9) Nervous - body trembling with shake lines on both sides, two or three glowing sweat drops beside the head, slightly shrunk. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

1) Smug - body leaning back with one pseudopod resting behind the head, relaxed and cocky. 2) Mind Blown - body wobbling dizzily, a translucent swirling dizzy ring with small droplets orbiting above the head. 3) Eye Roll - body slumped to one side, one pseudopod flopped out, unimpressed slouch. 4) Facepalm - one pseudopod pressed against the forehead above the face patch, body sagging. 5) Cool - body leaning back casually, a pair of glowing pixel-style sunglasses floating just above the face patch, a small sparkle. 6) Starstruck - body bouncing, motion arcs on both sides, glowing four-pointed sparkles bursting around the head. 7) Salute - one pseudopod raised in a crisp salute to the side of the head, body standing tall and straight, a few glowing bubbles above. 8) Shrug - two pseudopods stretched outward palms-up, body tilted. 9) Peek - only the top half of the body rising from the bottom edge of the cell, two tiny pseudopods gripping the edge. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

1) Teaching - standing beside a small pale-blue tinted glassy board with a navy edge, one pseudopod pointing at it. 2) Graduate - wearing a small navy graduation cap with a white tassel, body standing tall, a few glowing sparkles. 3) Clap - two pseudopods meeting mid-clap in front of the body, small glowing motion lines between them. 4) Encourage - two pseudopods raised cheering, glowing white sparkles all around, body bouncing. 5) Listening - body tilted attentively, one side stretched slightly toward the viewer, a glowing pale-blue soundwave floating beside the head. 6) Speaking - glowing pale-blue soundwave curves radiating from beside the face patch, body leaning forward. 7) 100 - body bouncing, a glowing pale-blue 100 floating above the head, sparkles. 8) Trophy - holding up a small trophy of pale-blue tinted gel with a navy edge in one pseudopod, body puffed proudly. 9) Book - holding a small open book of pale-blue gel pages with navy edge lines in two pseudopods, body hunched to read. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

1) Thanks - two pseudopods pressed together in a grateful gesture in front of the body, small glowing sparkles. 2) Dance - body bent in a playful S-curve mid-dance, two pseudopods out at angles, motion arcs. 3) Heart - the whole body reshaped into a soft rounded heart shape with the face patch centred, small glowing hearts floating. 4) Reading - holding a small pale-blue glassy tablet with navy frame in front, body leaning in absorbed. 5) Charging - body crackling with thin glowing pale-blue lightning arcs and sparks all around, a glowing bolt icon above, glow much brighter. 6) Hello - two pseudopods open wide in welcome, body leaning forward eagerly. 7) Curious - body tilted and leaning in, a small glowing question mark floating beside the head. 8) Proud - body puffed up tall and wide, two short pseudopods on the hips, a few glowing bubbles rising above. 9) High Five - one pseudopod raised flat forward for a high five, body leaning into it, small motion lines. Every prop is made of the same translucent pale-blue tinted gel with a thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white. Every floating symbol is glowing pale-blue #A8C7FF, never on the face patch.

reference_role: Reference image: Rumi's logo mark - two round dots connected by one smile curve, white on navy. This EXACT mark is Rumi's face. Reproduce it faithfully on the navy face patch in every cell: two glowing white dots as the eyes, joined by one continuous glowing white smile curve that arcs down from the bottom of the left dot to the bottom of the right dot. The dots sit at the two ends of the curve - the eyes and mouth are ONE connected shape, never a separate mouth floating below separate eyes.
